name: Jagjeevan Singh Soni
intro: Software developer with a structured approach to problem solving, a strong sense of ownership, and a commitment to continuous learning.
overviewSummary: Combines a foundation in computer engineering with professional experience in software delivery and cross-functional collaboration. Committed to advancing technical expertise through further study and applying sound engineering judgment to complex challenges.
about: At Amdocs, I work on enterprise telecom systems, from CRM and order management to release automation and production support. My projects extend that engineering practice into audio recognition, computer vision, and brain–computer interfaces.
direction: I am interested in deepening my technical foundations through graduate study, connecting practical software delivery with the study of computing systems and applied machine learning.

areas.title: Enterprise Telecom Systems
areas.text: Developed Java/Spring Boot microservices, REST APIs, and Oracle SQL solutions for enterprise Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Order Management System (OMS), integrating BSS and OSS workflows for order processing, provisioning, activation, and service changes across B2B/B2C telecommunications services.

areas.title: Application Migration & Modernization
areas.text: Migration of Amdocs Service Order Manager (SOM) to Order Delivery Orchestrator (ODO), supporting OSS-driven services orchestration and enterprise fixed-line products, including EWL, IPVPN, and Cisco SD-WAN. Migrated application scripts from 32-bit to 64-bit Linux and supported integration validation and production cutover.

areas.title: Delivery & Production Ownership
areas.text: Implemented Amdocs CRM enhancements and provide solutions using Java, Spring Boot, and SQL translating defined business requirements into functional solutions within an agile development environment.

areas.title: Automation & GenAI-Powered Engineering Platform
areas.text: Designed and developed a deployment validation application using Python, Flask, Oracle Database and Open PyXL automating database verification release tracking and Excel and email reporting. Built an internal GenAI - powered engineering platform using Cursor and MCPs, integrating Kafka, databases, Jira, Bit bucket, and unix operations; developed agentic AI and RAG workflows for production-defect analysis, root cause investigation, and order remediation.

areas.title: Customer Notifications & Email Enhancements
areas.text: Enhanced CRM customer notification framework to support communication triggered by order creation, updates and amendments. Automated template conversion, Git check-ins, release packaging, and deployment imports; developed and adapted Java dependency-analysis, SQL rollback, and secure file-transfer utilities.

education.headline: Foundations in Computer Science and Applied Mathematics.
education.summary: My undergraduate education built a strong foundation in computing, software systems, and analytical problem-solving, shaping how I approach complex technical challenges.
